Version Number Management Policy
nodes.rationale: Version number must be updated synchronously in 4 places (app.js VERSION, sw.js CACHE name, sw.js ASSETS ?v params, index.html script/style ?v params). Without coordinated cache-busting, a freshly downloaded page can run with stale cached scripts whose identifiers no longer match, causing silent failure on the first unknown reference.

nodes.label: Push Notification System via Cloudflare Worker and FCM
nodes.rationale: A static site cannot send push notifications itself, so a Cloudflare Worker intermediary is used. The app never sends device tokens to the Worker; it only sends a list ID and identity token. The Worker verifies membership and fetches tokens itself, preventing any account from spamming arbitrary devices.

nodes.label: Collaborative List Sharing Feature
nodes.rationale: Invitations are stored in Firestore keyed to the email address rather than sending actual emails, because the app has no server to send mail. Invitations by email also prevent address enumeration: the mapping from email to UID is only resolved when the recipient authenticates.

nodes.label: Friend Code Invitation System
nodes.source_location: On peut aussi inviter par code ami
nodes.rationale: Friend codes allow sharing list invitations without revealing the inviter's email address. Codes are stored in the `codes` collection, readable one-by-one if the exact code is known but never listable, preventing directory enumeration.

nodes.label: Administrator Accounts, Badges, and Announcements
nodes.rationale: Admin UID must be declared in both sync.js (Sync.MARQUES table) and firestore.rules (estAdmin function) and kept in sync. Using UID (not email) is the only identifier that Firestore rules can verify without spoofing. An admin is never blocked by their own announcement.

nodes.label: Display Name (Pseudo) System
nodes.rationale: Reserved pseudos are stored in the `pseudos` collection, readable one-by-one but never listable. A pseudo is normalized to lowercase with slashes replaced by spaces to prevent Firestore path injection. Admin pseudos are auto-reserved on save.

Iframe-Based Real-App Eval Test Harness
nodes.source_location: Tests de « Mes Listes » comment block, line 138
nodes.rationale: The app is loaded in an invisible iframe and driven via eval() executed in its window context. This is necessary because app variables are declared with const/let and do not become window properties — they would be invisible to an external frame. The app is loaded with ?tests=1 to skip service worker registration, preventing a mid-test reload after an update.
